simple.meaning: שְׂרֵפָה (sᵉrêphâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “cremation.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 13 times in Genesis, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, 2 Chronicles, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 11:3. The surrounding contexts include family, family line, offering, priesthood, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׂרֵפָה (H8316) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שְׂרֵפָה (sᵉrêphâh) / H8316 is traced through Genesis 11:3, Leviticus 10:6, Numbers 17:2, Numbers 19:6 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H8316. serephah שְׂרֵפָה noun feminine burning ; — absolute ׳שׂ Isa 9:4 +, construct שְׂרֵפַת Num 19:6 +; — ׳לשׁ of brick-burning Gen 11:3 (+ שָׁרַף ); destructive Amos 4:11 ; Isa 9:4 , of land Deut 29:22 , of temple, אֵשׁ לִשְׂרֵפַת הָיָה Isa 64:10 , שׁ ׳הַר Jer 51:25 i.e. a burnt-out volcano (figurative of Babylonian ); of heifer Num 19:6 , compare 19:17 ; of spices (probably) as funeral rite 2Chr 16:14 (as accusative of congnate meaning with verb), 21:19 (object of עָשָׂה ), 21:19 ; of person (penal) Lev 10:6 (accusative of congnate meaning with verb, ׳י subject), Num 17:2 .
